response.original_title: [FAQs™Passenger~Add] → How Do I Add a Passenger to My Costa Cruise? 2026–27
response.overview: You can add a passenger to an existing reservation by calling Costa Cruises Customer Service at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or by contacting your original travel agent 1-855-732-4023, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. To add a passenger to an existing Costa cruise booking 1-855-732-4023, you must call Costa Cruises customer service directly or contact your original travel agent 1-855-732- 4023. To add a passenger to an existing Costa Cruise reservation 1-855-732-4023, you must call Costa Cruises Customer Service directly or contact your travel agent, as additions cannot be processed online. To add a passenger to an existing Costa Cruise, you must call Costa Cruises Customer Service directly at +44-289-708-0062 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062, or contact your original travel agent, as additions cannot be made online.
